shared_elements: single large human(oid) figure occupying the whole field
carved stone surface in low relief
circle/disc motif (rosette-like disc on A's chest; disc-bracelets and rosettes on B)
horizontal banded/ridged detail across the body
incised linear rendering of drapery or garment surface
justification: Both are stone carvings dominated by a single large anthropomorphic figure whose torso is decorated with disc/rosette motifs and horizontal banding, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a frontal, heavily eroded, shallowly incised block with crude schematic forms, whereas B is a crisp, finely modelled profile relief on a flat rectangular slab with wings, musculature and delicately detailed accessories — the manner of rendering and the viewpoint are quite unlike.
